description: This file defines a class RevokeAuthenticationEvents which extends the CookieAuthenticationEvents to add custom logic for token validation, specifically revoking user access based on cache entries. It interacts with ASP.NET Core authentication and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
classes.description: Custom cookie authentication events class that overrides principal validation to revoke authentication based on cache entries.

methods.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache and logger dependencies.

methods.name: ValidatePrincipal
methods.description: Overridden method to validate the user's principal and revoke access if a cache entry indicates it has been revoked.
